title: Battery requires charging
fullDescription:
One flash on the status indicator means battery voltage is below threshold. Scooter will slow and eventually stop.

Return scooter to charging station; charge 8-12 hours.

Safety note: deep discharge damages batteries — charge before full depletion.

fixSteps.title: Charge batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Connect charger; leave 8-12 hours for full charge.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

title: Battery connection fault
fullDescription:
Two flashes indicate battery wiring fault — corroded terminals, loose connection, or failed battery.

Inspect battery terminals, clean corrosion, tighten connections.

Safety note: disconnect power before touching terminals. Wear gloves — battery acid is caustic.

fixSteps.title: Inspect terminals
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, open battery compartment, check for corrosion/looseness.

fixSteps.title: Clean and tighten
fixSteps.instruction: Clean with baking soda paste; tighten; apply terminal grease.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: When capacity drops below 70% or flashes persist after service.

title: Left motor fault
shortDescription: Left drive motor connection or fault.
fullDescription:
Three flashes indicate fault in left motor circuit — connector, brushes, or motor failure.

Check motor plug connections. If secure, motor may need professional service.

Safety note: do not attempt to operate with motor fault — scooter may pull to one side unpredictably.

fixSteps.title: Check plug
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect left motor connector; reseat firmly.

whenToCallPro: Contact Invacare dealer for motor service

faq.a: Not DIY — motor swap requires calibration.

title: Right motor fault
shortDescription: Right drive motor connection or fault.
fullDescription:
Four flashes indicate right motor circuit fault. Similar diagnosis to left motor.

Check right motor plug; professional service if connection is good.

Safety note: stop using until resolved.

fixSteps.title: Check right plug
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect and reseat right motor connector.

whenToCallPro: Contact Invacare dealer for motor service

faq.a: Pulls toward working side; faulty motor is opposite.

title: Parking brake fault
fullDescription:
Five flashes mean the freewheel lever is disengaged (scooter in push mode) or brake circuit fault.

Engage freewheel lever into drive position.

Safety note: never leave scooter in freewheel mode on any slope — it will roll.

fixSteps.title: Engage drive mode
fixSteps.instruction: Move freewheel lever to drive position.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Typically near rear wheels; check owner's manual.

title: Drive inhibit active
fullDescription:
Six flashes indicate the drive inhibit (e.g., charger plugged in, lift switch) is active, preventing movement.

Unplug charger and remove any inhibit accessories.

Safety note: this is a safety feature — do not bypass.
whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Prevents driving with charger cable attached — safety.

title: Throttle fault
shortDescription: Throttle not in neutral at power-on or throttle fault.
fullDescription:
Seven flashes indicate throttle was not centered when powered on, or throttle pot is faulty.

Release throttle, power off 10 seconds, power on without touching throttle.

Safety note: a stuck throttle is dangerous — if code persists, stop using.

fixSteps.title: Reset power
fixSteps.instruction: Power off 10 sec, release throttle, power on.

whenToCallPro: Contact dealer if throttle fault persists

faq.q: Can I drive with throttle error?

title: Controller fault
fullDescription:
Eight flashes indicate a main controller fault — usually requires dealer service.

Try power cycle; if code persists, contact Invacare.

Safety note: do not attempt to drive with controller fault.
whenToCallPro: Contact Invacare dealer — controller replacement requires professional service

title: Communication fault
fullDescription:
Nine flashes indicate loss of communication between joystick/tiller and main controller — often a cable issue.

Inspect cable between tiller and controller; reseat connectors.

Safety note: verify all repairs before use.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cables
fixSteps.instruction: Power off; unplug and reseat tiller data cable.

whenToCallPro: Contact dealer if reseating cables does not resolve

faq.a: Vibration from regular use can loosen connectors over time.

title: Overheat protection
fullDescription:
Ten flashes indicate thermal protection has engaged — scooter will not run until cool.

Park in shade for 30-60 minutes. Avoid continuous steep slopes.

Safety note: overheating often indicates overload; don't exceed weight limit.
whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Yes — repeated overheats shorten motor life.
